text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, sparkly miss! Do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Would you like to play house together?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...Fufu, thank you for the invitation.
I have something to take care of after this, so just for a little bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Papa~ Mama~ I'm ho~me. I'm starvi— wait.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wake up!
You'll catch a cold if you sleep in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(What should I do...
It's almost time for training, right...?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry, Trainer...!
I just can't leave these little ones behind!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After much internal conflict,
Almond Eye put off her training for later.
